mathematical_contract.endpoint_carrier_reuse: A mapped endpoint replays on an exact carrier that already owns the same point. An exactly rational companion point may be embedded as a constant expression in that selected field. No field compositum, approximate coordinate projection, or uncorrelated root matching is introduced.
mathematical_contract.distinct_field_chord: For start A(a), end B(b), and query C(c), Hypercurve constructs det(B-A,C-A) directly as one trivariate polynomial after clearing every projective denominator. The start denominator is squared; the physical sign therefore requires only the certified end and query denominator signs.
mathematical_contract.nonzero_sign: Each selected parameter is refined through target steps 0, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and 512. Restriction to the resulting parameter box followed by tensor power-to-Bernstein conversion proves a sign only when every control is strictly positive or every control is strictly negative.
mathematical_contract.zero_sign: Pairwise x/y endpoint equality is decided by the existing bivariate authorities before constructing a trivariate determinant, and an identically zero coefficient tensor is exact zero. A nonstructural three-field zero not proved by those authorities remains Predicate uncertainty in STRICT.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT accepts only exact structural, pairwise, or strict-sign proof. APPROXIMATE_512 traverses the identical graph, records the shared terminal, and may return zero/On only after the 512-bit box remains unresolved. Exact nonzero answers are policy-identical.
mathematical_contract.memory_bound: The chord determinant is populated directly into one dense coefficient tensor. More than 16384 controls returns explicit Unsupported. Each restricted refinement tensor is consumed in place by Bernstein conversion, avoiding a second full control-tensor clone.
mathematical_contract.failure: An unsupported endpoint carrier, tensor resource overflow, unresolved STRICT three-field equality, contradictory topology, or unsupported coefficient tower remains explicit. No f64 tolerance, chordized boundary, guessed equality, or silent policy fallback is used.

capability.comparison_revision: A mapped nonrational endpoint could classify only when both arc endpoints were representable in one selected local field, commonly by embedding an exactly rational companion. A fragment with two genuinely distinct endpoint fields remained Unsupported in its algebraic ray evaluator.
capability.source_revision: A disk split at sqrt(1/3) and sqrt(1/2) on a rational quarter-circle carrier now classifies independent algebraic inside, outside, and boundary queries through one authoritative CurveRegion2 winding path under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512.
capability.policy_terminal: For independently represented alpha=sqrt(1/2), beta=1-alpha, and gamma=alpha-1/2, the points (alpha,0), (0,beta), and (gamma,gamma) are mathematically collinear but no pair carries the full identity. STRICT returns explicit Predicate uncertainty; APPROXIMATE_512 returns On only after consuming its 512-bit terminal.
capability.bounded_failure: General correlated three-field zero proof remains the next exactness boundary; values separated from zero are now certified exactly, while resource or carrier limits remain explicit.
